verdict.rationale: Notte's scraping docs show structured extraction driven by a Pydantic `BaseModel` schema (the `HackerNewsFeed` example), and Fetch is documented as returning either markdown or LLM-extracted structured data. That means typed output, not just raw text. One user reported a failed extraction on hyatt.com, but this is a single site-specific failure and does not contradict the schema-typed extraction capability. Missing for 10: Zod/TypeScript schema support, documentation of how validation failures are handled, independent hands-on confirmation of typed extraction quality.
